basic_info.description: Nestled in the sought after Lower Pacific Heights neighborhood, 2663 California Street presents a rare opportunity to own a well maintained nine unit apartment building in one of San Francisco's most desirable locations. This classic three-story property features a mix of three thoughtfully designed floor plans, catering to a range of tenants:        Front & Rear Units:  Spacious and highly desirable, these apartments span approximately 700 sq. ft., offering an inviting layout with ample natural light.        Middle Units: Efficiently designed at 400 sq. ft., perfect for those seeking a cozy and functional living space.        Each unit is equipped with independent circuit breakers, separate water heaters, and an intercom entry system for added convenience and security. A shared laundry facility in the basement provides additional tenant amenities, while the private backyard offers a peaceful retreat in the heart of the city.        Although there is no parking on site, the property's prime location ensures easy access to public transportation, local shops, cafes, and the vibrant culture of Pacific Heights. This is an exceptional investment opportunity in a high demand rental market.
